pkgmetadata.longdescription: cua-driver is the computer-use automation driver from the trycua/cua project. It speaks MCP and takes screenshots, reads app UIs through AT-SPI and sends mouse and keyboard input. Hermes Agent's computer_use tool drives it. Built from source; the upstream self-updater is disabled because Portage owns the installed files.

use.flag: Install the WinRects GNOME Shell helper extension (window geometry, capture, agent cursor and verified focus on GNOME Wayland)
Enable GNOME/KDE input through the RemoteDesktop portal and dev-libs/libei (portal-input); required for mouse and keyboard on Wayland
